top source red_rot_magn_align

SST pipeline

result = red_rot_magn_align(im_ref_in, im_in [, /display], maxiter=maxiter)

Find rotation, magnification, and alignment parameters that align one image to another.

The images have to be fairly close to alignment on input. Just a few degrees of rotation, a few percent of relative magnification, and a shift of a few pixels. The images also have to have structures that are similar in the two images and contain enough information to determine a good match.

Return value

Parameters that make the image match the reference image as well as possible: [angle (deg), relative magnification, x shift, y shift]

Parameters

im_ref_in in type=image

The reference image.

im_in in type=image

Image to be aligned to the reference image.

Keywords

display in optional type=boolean

Display some image data.

maxiter
